'''Jennifer Foraziati-DaCosta''' <!--(born  ,  ,)--> is an American voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is sometimes credited as '''Jen DaCosta'''.

==Pokémon roles==
DaCosta began her work during {{aniseries|XY}}. Her major role was [[Nurse Joy]], before she was replaced by [[Kate Bristol]].
